title: Ringo to release book of Beatles photographs?
content:
Ringo Starr is considering publishing a book of his photographs of The Beatles, according to reports.

Art dealer Neal Glaser revealed on the weekly radio show Breakfast With The Beatles that he managed to persuade Starr to consider publishing a selection of his photographs of the group. The Beatles’ drummer, a keen photographer, is said to have many pictures of the group in his personal collection.

It has been suggested that the book will be a limited edition with each copy signed by Starr.
